title: OrganizerBillingPlanStatus
description: Which Catch plan an organizer is on, as status only (no prices), so the native Host app can show it under App Store guideline 3.1.3(f). ticketing is the default. toolsOnly with pendingPayment waits for its web payment; active applies from startsAtMillis (null: from the first billing cycle) until endsAtMillis (null: until cancelled).
